text:
1.1 Import Dataset


Lihat kode
# Menonaktifkan autentikasi Google
gs4_deauth() 

# Tautan dokumen sumber data
link_spreadsheet <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1u7L4GSSsuVDv9j7ccgWvccwr7A5Ks0szkiY-RTHVsA8/edit?usp=sharing"

# Membaca data penelitian
df <- read_sheet(link_spreadsheet, sheet = "DATA FINAL")

# Penyesuaian list columns dan tipe data
df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) {
  if (is.list(x)) {
    x <- unlist(lapply(x, function(v) if(is.null(v)) NA else as.character(v)))
  }
  return(x)
})
df <- as.data.frame(df, check.names = FALSE)

# Mapping nama variabel demografi agar mudah dianalisis (Menggunakan pencarian kata kunci agar anti-error)
df$Gender <- df[[ grep("Jenis Kelamin", names(df), ignore.case=TRUE)[1] ]]
df$Usia <- df[[ grep("Usia", names(df), ignore.case=TRUE)[1] ]]
df$Semester <- as.numeric(as.character(df[[ grep("Semester", names(df), ignore.case=TRUE)[1] ]]))
df$Provinsi <- df[[ grep("Daerah tempat tinggal", names(df), ignore.case=TRUE)[1] ]]
df$Area <- df[[ grep("menggambarkan area", names(df), ignore.case=TRUE)[1] ]]
df$Hunian <- df[[ grep("tempat tinggal utama", names(df), ignore.case=TRUE)[1] ]]


Dataset berisi 240 observasi dan siap digunakan untuk analisis lanjutan.

2.1 Statistik Deskriptif Demografi Responden


Lihat kode
print_demo_table <- function(variabel, labels) {
    freq <- table(variabel, useNA = "ifany")
    pct  <- prop.table(freq) * 100
    display <- sapply(names(freq), function(x) {
        if (is.na(x)) return("Missing")
        if (x %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[x]])
        return(x)
    })
    data.frame(
        Kategori   = unname(display),
        Frekuensi  = as.numeric(freq),
        Persentase = paste0(round(pct, 2), "%"),
        check.names = FALSE
    )
}
